Shah Rukh Khan Praises Captain Smit Machhar's Courage

Actor Shah Rukh Khan expressed admiration for the strong resolve of Captain Smit Machhar, stating that "putting oneself on the line is not easy." Khan conveyed that "you stood firm, the whole country is proud of you," and that he was impressed by Machhar's "unwavering courage."
